Let $\mathrm{f}:[2,4] \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ be a differentiable function such that $\left(\mathrm{x} \log _{\mathrm{e}} \mathrm{x}\right) \mathrm{f}^{\prime}(\mathrm{x})+\left(\log _{\mathrm{e}} \mathrm{x}\right) \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \geq 1, \mathrm{x} \in[2,4]$ with $\mathrm{f}(2)=\frac{1}{2}$ and $\mathrm{f}(4)=\frac{1}{4}$. (A) : $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \leq 1$, for all $\mathrm{x} \in[2,4]$
(B) : $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \geq \frac{1}{8}$, for all $\mathrm{x} \in[2,4]$
Then,
(1) Only statement (B) is true
(2) Only statement (A) is true
(3) Neither statement (A) nor statement (B) is true
(4) Both the statements (A) and (B) are true
